gen-gf-offside-gf-roboto: Roboto is a plain sans with generous mouths on every round letter. Offside earns its keep when big and short, its widely tracked letters and curves that refuse to close getting room to show off.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Autour One draws every curve at a single stroke weight, loud and expressive. Noto Sans Tangsa does the quiet work, its wide inviting openings keeping text approachable where the heading shouts.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Glyphs like tiles, grout lines wide: that is Audiowide. Noto Sans Brahmi keeps the reading smooth across a full page, its high mean line and open-ended curves making each line easy to follow.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-stack-sans-head: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, loud and expressive, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Stack Sans Headline shares the monoline skeleton, and that is the tie.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-stack-sans-notch: Gugi's lowercase climbs nearly to the capitals, bold and distinctive. Stack Sans Notch handles the quieter job, its open curves and rod-stock horizontals and verticals giving the heading's drama a place to rest.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham has generous entry space on its open curves and tall rounded lowercase forms, modern and clean. Audiowide adds the futuristic edge while the text below just flows.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-bespoke-sans: A sign-painter's single-stroke brush look at constant width defines Oldenburg. Bespoke Sans takes over with sharp, refined shapes, generous space between curve ends and stem, so text moves along comfortably.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-bespoke-sans: Commanding and distinctive, Oxanium sets big lowercase on monoline strokes. Bespoke Sans takes the hand-off with sharp, refined shapes, giving those full-weight tails and terminals space to breathe beside it.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee has a thickness like neon glass tubing, approachable and friendly. Terminals finish well away from the stem and the mean line sits high, so extended text moves easily beneath Oxanium.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-alexandria: Alexandria has a tall body with short stems above and below and terminals that stay generously open. Oxanium's uniform strokes up top lead into text that moves along smoothly.
